description: Searches for messages and files matching a query.

query.description: Search query. May contain booleans, etc.

count.description: Number of results per page. Default: 20.

highlight.description: Pass true to enable query highlight markers. Default: false.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default: 1.

sort.description: Return matches sorted by score or timestamp. Default: score.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.

team_id.description: Encoded team id to search in (required if org token is used).
